svg.text: RPython architecture
Public API (Python package) / rpython R package
rp.R() · r("code") · r["x"] = obj · r.package() · proxies · rp.panel / timeseries / spatial / network · rp.connect · rp.save/load · %%r magics · rp.doctor / explain_last · python() from R
Beginner: one line per operation. Advanced: transfer backend, lossy/missing policy, memory threshold, raw envelopes, custom adapters.
Semantic data layer
Detection → classification (confirmed / inferred / suggestion)
Type negotiation → transfer plan (json / arrow-ipc / shared file / lazy / proxy)
Adapters per family: registry, tiers A→E, fidelity report
src/rpython/data/* · memory guard · Explain Mode history
Database layer
ConnectionRef (secret-free) + SecretVault
Lazy Relation: pushdown, bound params, Arrow batches
Adapters: SQL · DuckDB · lakes · document · KV · graph · TS · vector · search
src/rpython/database/*
Portable envelope (RPX)
JSON with explicit NA/NaN/Inf tokens + semantic sidecars · Arrow IPC files for columnar payloads · WKB for geometry · handles for proxies · shared paths for files / databases
R companion package (isolated Rscript worker)
rpx_encode / rpx_decode · sf, igraph, Matrix, xts, haven, survival, plm, terra …
Python worker (driven by R)
same protocol · pandas, numpy, sklearn, torch … · object store for proxies
